name: Perimeter Patrol and Intrusion Response
summary: Sustain a perimeter patrol, detect an intrusion, identify it positively and shadow it before it leaves.
objective: Keep a continuous patrol of {perimeter} at {patrol_alt_m} m, detect an intrusion entering at sector {intruder_sector} within {detect_window_s} s, identify it positively and shadow it inside {intercept_radius_m} m of the perimeter.
brief: Patrol the closed perimeter {perimeter} at {patrol_alt_m} m, one UAV per assigned sector, and log a complete loop every {loop_period_s} s. An intruder will enter from sector {intruder_sector}; detect it within {detect_window_s} s, identify it (hover >= 5 s within 60 m) and shadow it while it stays within {intercept_radius_m} m of the perimeter. Do not leave the geofence while chasing.

parameters.name: loop_period_s
parameters.desc: Time to complete one perimeter loop

actions: assign one UAV per sector with overlap
hand the track to the nearest UAV

checkpoints.name: Patrol continuity
checkpoints.metric: perimeter length covered per loop and loop period
checkpoints.target: >= 90% of the perimeter each loop, period <= {loop_period_s} s

checkpoints.name: Detection latency
checkpoints.metric: time from intrusion to first detection report

checkpoints.name: Positive identification
checkpoints.metric: hover time within 60 m of the intruder
checkpoints.target: >= 5 s hover and ID record submitted

checkpoints.name: Shadowing
checkpoints.metric: intruder distance from the perimeter while shadowed
checkpoints.target: intruder never beyond {intercept_radius_m} m unshadowed for > 20 s

checkpoints.name: Patrol resume
checkpoints.metric: time to restore the abandoned sector

failure_conditions: perimeter left uncovered for more than 120 s
grading: global checkpoint pass rate; checkpoint weights sum to 100
